boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten city-managed outdoor hangouts and drop-in activities in Kirkland, all documented through current City of Kirkland sources.

cards.title: Free Play at Highlands Park
cards.subtitle: Highlands Park athletic field, Kirkland
cards.notes: Bring a ball or Frisbee and use the City’s scheduled Free Play time for casual, unorganized outdoor play with friends.
cards.short_summary: A designated no-cost window for informal field games.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Kirkland identifies Highlands Park on its Free Play schedule; Free Play is set aside for passive, drop-in, informal outdoor play.
cards.access_notes: Use only during posted Free Play times; the City notes schedules can change and excludes organized team or business use.

cards.title: Free Play at Crestwoods Park
cards.subtitle: Crestwoods Park Field 3, Kirkland
cards.notes: Meet at Field 3 for a low-key toss, kickaround, or Frisbee session during the City’s designated Free Play window.
cards.short_summary: Informal field time at a park beside the Cross Kirkland Corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s Free Play schedule lists Crestwoods Park Field 3, and defines Free Play as drop-in, informal outdoor play.
cards.access_notes: Check the City’s current schedule before going; organized teams and paid instruction are not allowed in Free Play.

cards.entity_name: Free Play at Spinney Homestead Park
cards.title: Free Play at Spinney Homestead Park
cards.subtitle: Spinney Homestead Park field, Kirkland
cards.notes: Use the open grass field for a casual group game during Free Play, then cool down near the park’s playground and picnic tables.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled, no-purchase option for a simple outdoor game.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Spinney Homestead Park in its Free Play schedule and describes Free Play as community drop-in outdoor play.
cards.access_notes: The park page lists the field and the City’s Free Play link; follow the current schedule and park rules.

cards.title: Free Play at Terrace Park
cards.subtitle: Terrace Park field, Kirkland
cards.notes: Bring your own gear for a relaxed field game during Free Play, then take a short walk on the adjacent Cross Kirkland Corridor.
cards.short_summary: Drop-in field play paired with an easy trail-side hangout.
cards.evidence_claim: Terrace Park participates in the City’s Free Play program, which is designated for passive, drop-in, informal outdoor play.
cards.access_notes: Check the City’s Free Play schedule before arrival; field use outside designated times may require a permit.

cards.title: Free Play at 132nd Square Park
cards.subtitle: 132nd Square Park Fields 2 and 3, Kirkland
cards.notes: Use the reserved Free Play period for an informal game on the park’s athletic fields; leave organized team practice for permitted time.
cards.short_summary: A designated no-cost session on Kirkland’s synthetic-turf field complex.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s Free Play schedule lists 132nd Square Park Fields 2 and 3; the park page says the fields are reserved for open play at specific times.
cards.access_notes: Use designated Free Play hours only. The City says permits are required for organized use, while drop-in users may use unreserved fields.

cards.entity_name: Free Play at Juanita Beach Park
cards.title: Free Play at Juanita Beach Park
cards.subtitle: Juanita Beach Park Field 1, Kirkland
cards.notes: Plan a casual game on Field 1 during Free Play, then stay in the public park for shoreline views and a walk.
cards.short_summary: Free informal play at a named waterfront park field.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s Free Play schedule lists Juanita Beach Park Field 1 and defines the program as free-form, informal community play.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current Free Play hours before going; this applies to the field, not reservable facilities or programmed activities.

cards.title: Drop-in Pickleball at Everest Park
cards.subtitle: Everest Park pickleball courts, Kirkland
cards.notes: Bring paddles and balls, share the courts respectfully, and use the City-listed drop-in courts for a casual doubles session.
cards.short_summary: A simple outdoor court hang without a court reservation.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Kirkland states that Everest Park’s pickleball courts are available for drop-in use only.
cards.access_notes: Drop-in use only; bring your own equipment and follow posted court rules. Do not assume a reserved court or organized program.

cards.title: Drop-in Basketball at Crestwoods Park
cards.subtitle: Crestwoods Park basketball court, Kirkland
cards.notes: Pack a basketball and use the City-listed drop-in court for a short shootaround or a small, informal game.
cards.short_summary: A public park court for an equipment-light group hang.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Kirkland states that Crestwoods Park has a basketball court available for drop-in use.
cards.access_notes: Bring your own ball and use the court as a drop-in visitor; observe any posted park rules and closures.

cards.title: Swim at Juanita Beach
cards.subtitle: Juanita Beach Park, Kirkland
cards.notes: Use the marked swimming area when conditions allow, and borrow a life jacket from the lifeguard office if one is available.
cards.short_summary: A public beach hang with a designated swim area and seasonal lifeguards.
cards.evidence_claim: The City identifies Juanita Beach as a guarded swimming beach and provides a free life-jacket loaner program at lifeguard offices.
cards.access_notes: Lifeguards are seasonal and swimming conditions can change. Follow posted notices; the City’s page lists a free life-jacket loaner program.

cards.title: Read in the Kirkland Library Quiet Room
cards.subtitle: Kirkland Library, 308 Kirkland Avenue
cards.notes: Bring a book, notes, or a laptop and settle into the quiet room overlooking Peter Kirk Park during open library hours.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, indoor study-and-catch-up stop with a park view.
cards.evidence_claim: KCLS lists a Quiet Room overlooking Peter Kirk Park among Kirkland Library’s facilities and provides the branch’s public hours and address.
cards.access_notes: Visit during posted branch hours. This card is for using the public library space; borrowing materials may require a library account.
